description: Live Indeed job listings for Denmark, Sweden, Norway and 57 other Indeed country sites: title, company, location, salary (where shown), job type, remote flag, posting date and apply link. Up to 50 jobs per call. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller) from its Indeed scraper; cached up to 1 h. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

includeDescription.description: Include plain-text job description (truncated to 4000 chars). Default false.

keywords.description: Comma-separated job searches, up to 3 (e.g. "developer,data analyst"). Required unless location is set.

location.description: City, region or postcode inside the chosen country, e.g. København, Stockholm, Oslo. Omit for the whole country.

minSalary.description: Keep only jobs whose shown yearly-equivalent salary reaches this (local currency); drops jobs without salary

radius.description: Radius around location (km; miles on us/gb)

name: indeed_jobs
